run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Slack system, prioritizing the primary pricing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start by deeply analyzing the primary pricing page, including toggling billing periods and validating feature comparisons. It will then traverse the adjacent acquisition flows (Get Started, Sign In, Contact Sales) to test form validations and state changes. Next, it will validate the core marketing pages (Features, Solutions, Enterprise, Trust) and their deep links. Finally, the run will repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to assess responsiveness and tap target issues identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The yearly/monthly toggle on pricing.html dynamically updates the prices and feature details without a full page reload.
The contact form and sign-in forms have client-side validation that can be triggered by submitting empty or invalid data.
Deep links with hashes (e.g., features.html#channels) correctly scroll to or highlight the relevant section on the target page.
The 'Get started free' buttons across the site consistently route to the get-started.html page.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: Billing toggle (Monthly/Annual) and feature comparison table layout on smaller screens
contact.html: Form validation, required field handling, and submission state
signin.html: Password recovery flow and error messaging for invalid credentials
index.html: Small tap targets for footer and inline links (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels') on mobile

phases.title: Pricing Flow Deep Dive
phases.objective: Validate the primary pricing page interactions, billing toggle, and feature comparison table.
key_checks: Toggle between Monthly and Annual billing and verify price updates
Expand/collapse the 'Compare all features' table
Click category filters (All, Productivity, AI) if they affect the comparison table
Verify 'Get started free' and 'Contact sales' buttons for each plan
Check FAQ section expand/collapse behavior
exit_criteria: Feature comparison table is fully expanded and filtered
All plan CTA buttons are clicked and verified

phases.title: Acquisition & Auth Flows
phases.objective: Test the signup, signin, and sales contact forms for validation, state changes, and recovery paths.
key_checks: Submit get-started.html with empty email to trigger validation
Submit signin.html with invalid credentials to observe error state
Click 'Forgot your password?' and verify the reset UI appears
Fill out and submit the contact.html form, checking required field validation and the success state ('Thank you!' heading)
exit_criteria: Form validation errors are triggered on all three forms
Contact form success state is observed

phases.title: Core Marketing & Deep Links
phases.objective: Validate navigation, deep links, and content rendering on feature and solution pages.
key_checks: Click deep links from index.html (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels', 'Explore AI in Slack') and verify scroll/navigation on features.html
Verify features.html internal tab navigation (Collaboration, Project Management, Integrations, Intelligence)
Click 'Learn more' links on solutions.html for various departments
Verify enterprise.html CTA navigation and content layout
exit_criteria: All index.html deep links successfully navigate to the correct section
Features page tabs switch content correctly
Solutions page links are clicked and verified

phases.title: Supporting Pages & Trust
phases.objective: Cover the remaining supporting pages to ensure complete flow coverage and link integrity.
key_checks: Verify trust.html security and compliance sections render correctly
Click 'Contact sales' from trust.html
Verify resources.html cards (Help Centre, Developers, etc.) are clickable
Check about.html layout and stats section
exit_criteria: All three pages are fully scrolled and visually verified
Primary CTAs on these pages are clicked

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness Check
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical flows and layout on a mobile viewport, addressing prescan tap target warnings.
key_checks: Verify mobile navigation menu (hamburger) opens and closes on index.html
Check pricing.html table layout and billing toggle on mobile
Validate get-started.html form inputs and social login buttons on mobile
Assess tap target sizes for footer links and inline text links
exit_criteria: Pricing comparison is readable and toggleable on mobile
Signup form is usable on mobile

coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible toggles, form submissions, deep link navigations, and tab filters
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks on mobile viewport, specifically targeting known small tap targets and form layouts

notes: Prescan flagged multiple small tap targets (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels' at 200x18px). Pay close attention to these during the mobile phase.
The contact form has a hidden 'Thank you!' heading which implies a client-side success state; ensure the form is filled out completely to trigger this.
The signin page has a hidden 'Reset your password' heading, indicating a client-side toggle for the forgot password flow.

prescan_summary.title: Trust & Security – Slack
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. observation.title: Trust & Security – Slack
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management and domain claiming keep your workspace secure. Privacy Principles We don't sell your data. We don't use customer data to train AI models. Your data belongs to you, and we provide tools to manage it. Privacy & Terms Privacy Policy How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you use Slack services. Terms of Service The agreement between you and Slack governing your use of our platform and services. Cookie Policy How we use cookies and similar technologies to provide, customise and improve our services. Data Processing Our data processing addendum for customers who need to comply with GDPR and other regulations. Security questions? Our team is here to help with your security and compliance needs. observation.title: Slack Features – Team Collaboration Tools
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free One platform for your entire workday All the features of Slack work together so you can too. Collaboration Project Management Integrations Intelligence Collaboration Bring people, projects, knowledge and culture under one roof. # Channels Collaborate in real time with transparent conversations. Create channels around teams, projects or anything else. SC Slack Connect Turn partners into team members and break down boundaries, with secure collaboration right in Slack. H Huddles Work together in real time through audio and video meetings, including screen sharing. C Clips Share audio ideas or screen recordings with clips — all without leaving Slack. M Messaging Chat with your team in real time. Share files, react with emojis, and keep conversations organised. E Enterprise Scale securely with features designed for large organisations with complex needs. Project Management Keep projects on track without leaving the conversation. T Templates Start any task fast with ready-to-use templates. On Enterprise+, publish custom templates for your company. Ca Canvas Create rich, flexible docs with text, files, images and videos directly in a Slack canvas. L Lists Collaboratively manage projects and organise tasks in Slack lists. Track progress without switching tools. F File Sharing Bring files into the flow of work. Share, comment and collaborate on documents without leaving Slack. Integrations & Automation Connect your tools and automate your workflows. 2.6K Apps & Integrations Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT and more. WF Workflow Builder Automate routine tasks and processes directly in Slack, no coding required. Build with drag-and-drop simplicity. AP Agentic Platform Customise, extend and unify your tech stack in Slack. Deploy custom functions on Slack's secure infrastructure. CS Custom Workflow Steps Let developers bring org-specific systems into workflows with Slack APIs and custom steps. Intelligence Tap into your company's collective knowledge to work smarter. AI Slack AI Catch up instantly with channel and thread summaries, schedule daily recaps and take huddle notes automatically. SB Slackbot Your personal AI agent for work that knows you and your team. It adapts to your style, finds what you need and helps get work done faster. AF Agentforce Ask an agent to analyse customer data, draft emails, provide recommendations on sales opportunities and more.
